        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

prog='''
def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    rows=[r for r in set(r for r,c in pts) if sum(1 for rr,cc in pts if rr==r)>=2]
    row=rows[0]
    cols=sorted(c for r,c in pts if r==row)
    c1,c2=cols[0],cols[-1]
    for c in range(c1,c2+1):
        if g[row][c]==0: g[row][c]=3
    for (r,c) in pts:
        if r==row: continue
        for rr in range(min(r,row),max(r,row)+1):
            if g[rr][c]==0: g[rr][c]=3
    return g
'''
open('/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl-u1-turns/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u046/system/state/workspace/programs/task-578c69dc.py','w').write(prog)
